preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 1 and 10^6, inclusive.
The number written on each vertex is between 1 and 10^6, inclusive.
The vertices x and y are valid vertex indices within the tree.
The vertices x and y are distinct.
The edges form a tree structure, meaning there are no cycles and all vertices are connected.

postconditions.expression: The output is a single integer
postconditions.description: The output is a single integer that represents the maximum value of I(x, y) over all pairs of vertices (x, y) in the tree.
